papers.title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
papers.reason: It presents a Bayesian context-inference and recurrent-memory model of human working and episodic memory that is directly validated against human fMRI representations and retrieval behaviour.

papers.title: Better Behavioral Prediction, More Faithful Model Ablations? Evidence from Sequential Choice
papers.reason: The experiments use synthetic sequential-choice generators without human or animal data, and the central object is predictive-model ablation fidelity rather than an explicit model of human executive function.

papers.title: Multidimensional Vulnerability Profiles Among Older Adults in Chinese Integrative-Care Settings: A Cross-Sectional Assessment of Function, Cognition, Clinical Risk, and TCM Constitution.
papers.reason: The study broadly assesses cognition in older adults but does not specifically address executive-function mechanisms, computational models, or digital biomarkers.

papers.title: Analysis of the Mediating Role of Cytokines in the Relationship Between Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and Cognitive Impairment After Ischemic Stroke.
papers.reason: This clinical mediation study concerns general post-stroke cognitive impairment rather than executive-function modelling or task-based cognitive biomarkers.

papers.title: Altered Inter-Network Functional Integration Underlies Speech Impairment in Parkinson's Disease: A Resting-State fMRI Analysis.
papers.reason: The resting-state connectivity findings may offer general network-level context, but the target phenotype is speech impairment rather than executive function.

papers.title: A novel sequence modeling and corticobasal degeneration classification method: leaky integrator RNN
papers.reason: The paper applies sequence modelling to clinical classification, but the title provides no indication that executive-task, eye-tracking, or EEG features are central.

papers.title: GitHarness: Git Init Your Harness Working Memory for Perpetual User Requirements
papers.reason: The term working memory refers to an LLM agent's persistent task state rather than human or animal cognition.

papers.title: Rural-urban disparities in the clinical diagnostic pathway of patients with all-cause mild cognitive impairment and dementia due to Alzheimer's disease in Australia.
papers.reason: The paper addresses healthcare access and diagnostic pathways rather than executive-function mechanisms or cognitive measurement methods.

papers.title: Effects of language of test administration as a predictor of progression to Alzheimer's disease in bilingual Hispanic Americans: A pilot study.
papers.reason: Language-dependent cognitive-test performance is relevant to fair early-detection assessment, although no executive-function-specific or multimodal method is indicated.

papers.title: Decoupling of local activity and interhemispheric connectivity in late mild cognitive impairment: A resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging study.
papers.reason: The study identifies resting-state activity and interhemispheric-connectivity changes across MCI stages, but it does not isolate executive-function processes.

papers.title: Patients with amnestic mild cognitive impairment are compromised in temporal order memory.
papers.reason: The behavioral task reveals impaired temporal sequence organization in aMCI and links it to Trail Making Test B performance, offering useful findings for process-oriented assessment.

papers.title: Psychometric properties of the Survey of Health, Aging, and Retirement in Europe Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (SHARE-HCAP).
papers.reason: The cross-national factor analysis validates an executive-function domain within a broader cognitive battery but is not a digital or mechanistic assessment study.

papers.title: Socio-cognitive models in a patch foraging setting: a case study for model selection and parameter identifiability methods
papers.reason: The paper compares mechanistic drift-diffusion models of social evidence representation and integration using Bayesian model selection and parameter-identifiability analysis.

papers.title: Prevalence and factors associated with cognitive impairment in symptomatic intracranial atherosclerotic disease: A prospective observational study.
papers.reason: The study estimates general MoCA-defined impairment and clinical risk factors without examining executive-function mechanisms or specialized digital measures.

papers.title: Lower Task-Estimated Visual Working Memory Capacity in Adults with Epilepsy: A Cross-Sectional Quantitative Assessment Using Eye Tracking
papers.reason: This is a close methodological match combining a graded visual-working-memory task, gaze-based responses, eye-movement measures, and clinical-control classification.

papers.title: Human Health Effects of Environmental Micro and Nanoplastic (MNP) Exposure: Linking Hippocampal Memory and Neurodegenerative Mechanisms
papers.reason: The proposed human behavioral and cellular study targets hippocampal episodic memory and toxic exposure rather than executive function or working memory.

papers.title: Predictive Value of Electroacupuncture for Cognitive Outcomes in Mild Cognitive Impairment: A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.reason: The exploratory model predicts global MoCA response to electroacupuncture from treatment and clinical variables rather than executive-function biomarkers.

papers.title: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) in schizophrenia: enhancing transparency in clinical decision-making
papers.reason: The review discusses explainable classification using multimodal clinical, neuroimaging, electrophysiological, and genetic data, but executive-function assessment is not central.

papers.title: Global Trends and Research Hotspots of Interventions for Post-Stroke Cognitive Impairment: A Bibliometric Analysis from 2005 to 2025
papers.reason: This bibliometric mapping of intervention literature provides no direct model, cognitive-task result, or biomarker finding.

papers.title: Childhood trauma and cognitive decline in women: an empirical analysis of cognitive vulnerability in later life
papers.reason: The study associates childhood neglect with global MoCA and clinical-staging scores but does not analyze executive-function processes specifically.

papers.title: Factor structure of the neuropsychological battery in the Mexican Cognitive Aging Ancillary Study (Mex-Cog).
papers.reason: The study establishes an executive-function factor within a culturally relevant aging battery, supporting assessment design but not mechanistic or digital modelling.

papers.title: Optimal cutoffs for the Montreal Cognitive Assessment among English and Spanish speaking Latinos.
papers.reason: The study improves demographic and language-specific MCI and dementia screening thresholds, but it concerns global MoCA classification rather than executive-function biomarkers.

papers.title: Perioperative Predictors and Temporal Trajectories of Postoperative Cognitive Decline After Carotid Endarterectomy: A Prospective Cohort Study
papers.reason: The paper predicts MoCA-defined postoperative decline and trajectories from clinical variables, but it lacks executive-process measures and digital or physiological cognitive biomarkers.

papers.title: Neurocognitive Indices of Long COVID: Dysregulated Engagement of Inhibitory Control and Oscillatory Slowing
papers.reason: Task and resting EEG reveal altered inhibitory-control engagement, error-related synchrony, and oscillatory slowing in Long COVID despite intact overt performance.

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of remote self-administered digital cognitive assessment by clinical diagnosis and Alzheimer's disease PET imaging biomarkers
papers.reason: The large prospective study validates a scalable remote digital cognitive battery against clinical MCI or dementia diagnoses and amyloid and tau PET biomarkers.

papers.title: Cracking the predictive stability code: dual trial-by-trial spatio-temporo-spectral dynamics of task representation directional tuning by Bayesian conflict expectations
papers.reason: The paper combines trial-level Bayesian conflict-expectation modelling with EEG representational analyses to explain proactive and predictive-reactive cognitive-control mechanisms.

papers.title: EasyCog: a fast and effective numerical tool for the self-assessment of cognitive functions
papers.reason: The tool appears relevant to digital self-assessment, although the available title does not establish executive-function specificity or clinical validation.

papers.title: Alcohol use disorder accelerates age-related cognitive decline
papers.reason: The title indicates a general clinical finding about cognitive decline without identifying executive-function mechanisms, modelling, or digital assessment.

papers.title: Awareness-dependent Attentional Templates: Neural Mechanism Differentiation Driven by Visual Working Memory Load.
papers.reason: Behavior and EEG identify awareness- and load-dependent mechanisms linking visual working memory to attentional guidance through alpha and theta-alpha coupling.

papers.title: Patterns of Alpha-band Power Reflect Prioritization of the Most Recently Encoded Location in a Working Memory Sequence.
papers.reason: EEG inverted-encoding analyses directly reveal how covert spatial attention sequentially prioritizes locations during visual working-memory maintenance.
